open_points.subject: A12/A04 value size checks for `many` value ports
open_points.text: A12 rule 1: "for a `many` port, is a JSON array whose every element fits it — and is within `stored_value_bytes_max`"; A04 rule 1 applies size checks by port but does not state whether `stored_value_bytes_max` on `many` values is per element, whole array value, or both.
open_points.question: For `many` value ports, is `stored_value_bytes_max` enforced on each element, on the full JSON array as one value, or on both?
options: enforce on both array and each element
open_points.default_guess: enforce on the whole array value only, since a `many` port value is still one JSON value record.

open_points.subject: A09 attempt outcome boundary (`not_sent` vs `unknown`)
open_points.text: A09 rule 5: "'Nothing could be sent' holds only when the failure happened before the kernel wrote the first byte of the request; any failure after that... is 'may have been sent'."
open_points.question: What exact transport signals must implementation use to decide whether the first request byte was written, especially with buffered HTTP clients and TLS handshake/write failures?
options: classify as `not_sent` only when the client reports zero request bytes written with certainty; otherwise `unknown`
map specific exception classes heuristically to pre-send vs post-send
treat all transport failures before status line as `unknown` for non-read operations
open_points.default_guess: use a conservative rule: `not_sent` only with explicit certainty of zero bytes written; otherwise `unknown`.

open_points.subject: A13 resting run output shape
open_points.text: A13 rule 7: "A run that rests returns the outputs produced so far; the per-output reasons below are given only once it has ended."
open_points.question: When a run is resting, how are not-yet-produced flow outputs represented in the run response: omitted, present with null, or present with a pending marker?
options: omit unproduced outputs until run end
include all outputs with null for unproduced ones
include all outputs with an explicit interim reason
open_points.default_guess: omit unproduced outputs and return only produced outputs while resting.
